name: The Ramparts of Ice
summary: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

name: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal – Wo schmeckt's am besten?
In Love Forever
summary: Ranlaphat and Phiracha dream of holding hands through every trial, of a long-lasting love, of growing old together. But those dreams collapse without warning, forcing the couple to face one obstacle after another.

name: Battle of Fates
summary: Korea's top 49 Fate Readers—from tarot readers to shamans—fight for pride. Who will be the winner?

name: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
summary: When high school student Cassie Stoddart is found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community is gripped by fear that a random killer is on the loose. Police retrace Cassie's final hours and focus on three classmates that were the last people to see her alive. As the investigation narrows, detectives uncover a shocking buried video tape that reframes the case, raising the unthinkable question of whether 16-year-olds could have committed such a brutal crime.

name: Krömer - Late Night Show
summary: In Krömer - Late Night Show, chaotic Berlin comedian Kurt Krömer hosts a dysfunctional, surreal talk show featuring bizarre sketches, absurd interviews, and unconventional musical acts, blending traditional late-night tropes with anarchic, deadpan humo

previousepisode.name: Karel Gott, Wolfgang Rademann, Musik von Karel Gott

name: Girl from Nowhere: The Reset
summary: "If everything stayed the same, it wouldn't be called karma, right?" When the world as it is still seems to need Nanno to shake things up.

name: La Caméra explore le temps
summary: This French TV series from the 1950s and 60s explored historical events using dramatic reenactments, bringing history to life for its viewers.

name: Мотай!
summary: Timofey Nazarov, the head of the colony in the remote taiga, still dreams of escaping to the capital — and is betting on cinema again. But Nikolai Videnin was released, and now Nazarov is transferring a new prisoner to his colony — the famous Moscow director Matvey Selyuzhitsky, who gets the nickname "Motor" and begins to reshoot iconic Hollywood action films.

name: Inside The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
summary: Inside The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin is a companion series hosted by Megan Basham, breaking down what you saw, what you missed, and what it all means, revealing layers of symbolism and ideas that make every episode worth a second watch. Watch the 7-part series now — only on DailyWire+. New Episodes Every Thursday.

name: Mpondoland
summary: In a sacred marijuana cultivating village, Mkhondwana must protect his community's traditions, spirituality, cultural heritage, holy land and control of their valuable resources, from the pharmaceutical mogul Pele-Pele.

name: Class Crush Crisis
summary: Leeith dreams of becoming a cool indie rock musician. Because of his complete disregard for his studies, his mother sends him to one of the country's most prestigious high schools, one that's accepting male students for the first time this year. Attending a school with girls for the first time, he sets himself a strict rule to keep love from ruining friendship. He soon clashes with studious Putter who ends up being his roommate. However, as he and his roommate grow closer, he finds himself challenged to follow his own rule.

name: ReLIFE: Kanketsu-hen
summary:
After reliving the life of a high school student through the ReLIFE experiment, 27-year-old Arata Kaizaki cannot believe how quickly it has changed him. He has begun to see the world through a different perspective that he had completely forgotten as an adult. He has made friends and formed deep relationships with each one of them. However his support, Ryou Yoake, reminds him that the experiment is all an illusion; after his experiment ends, he will be forgotten by all of them.

The experiment of another ReLIFE subject is also coming to an end. After spending two years with ReLIFE, Chizuru Hishiro has developed into a more open, more thoughtful person than she could have ever imagined. She has met people who have changed her life, her perspective, and ultimately her. However, now that their ReLIFE is coming to an end, will they be able to let go of the memories they have made?

This is OVA/ONA hybrid, as it was released on the same day on blu-ray disc as well as multiple local Internet streaming platforms.

name: Kill Tony
summary: Kill Tony, a live podcast taped in Austin, Texas and all over the world. Aspiring comedians are randomly drawn from a bucket to perform a one-minute set, followed immediately by an interview and feedback from Tony Hinchcliffe, Brian Redban, and celebrity guests.

name: MAFS: After The Dinner Party
summary:
An all new companion show to MAFS.

Picking up right where the Married at First Sight dinner party drama left off, this official inside scoop on Australia's biggest show is the only place to witness the unfiltered truth behind the love, bitter conflicts, and jaw-dropping betrayals.

name: Lesbian Sex & Sexuality
summary: In a nation where lesbian sex, lust and sexual representation are marginalized, this series goes beyond mass appeal to find out what really turns on women who like women.

name: NBA All-Star Saturday
summary: NBA All-Star Saturday is a marquee All-Star Weekend event featuring high-energy skill competitions, including the Skills Challenge, State Farm 3-Point Contest, Kia Shooting Stars, and the iconic AT&T Slam Dunk Contest. It showcases the league's best shooters, dunkers, and creators, making it a fan-favorite night for viral moments and skill exhibition.

name: NBA Rising Stars Game
summary: The league's brightest rookies, sophomores, and G League standouts collide in a high-octane, four-team mini-tournament to stake their claim as the future faces of basketball during All-Star Weekend.

previousepisode.name: The Siege of the Six Giant Monsters

name: Hell University
summary: After discovering Hell University, a group of friends is forced into a lawless school where murder is allowed every night. As fear threatens to break them apart, Zein fights to keep her friends alive while uncovering a system designed to make no one leave.

name: Asylum
summary: The Barad family, forced to flee their war-torn country, embarks on a journey to Europe with the help of a smuggler, only to find themselves trapped on an island. There, refugees from various countries are forced into deadly games, broadcast live to the deep web through cameras scattered across the island for an international betting syndicate. The rules are brutal: The survivors will be granted asylum in their chosen country, while those who fail will perish.

name: The Diner Anthologies
summary: Anthology series in which chance encounters at a diner uncover the secrets of those who sit at its tables.

name: Ed Henry the Big Take
summary: Ed Henry offers his common-sense take on the news.

name: Love Songs Love Series: Still Single
summary: A group of four single female friends share the dream of travelling around the world. To do so, they all choose to study in the Faculty of Aviation Business to fulfil it. How fun, bright, chaotic, and dramatic will this gang be? And will any man cross the wall to release their single status?

name: U Prince Series: Brian
summary: Mantou, a Mafia boss's daughter, dreams of getting married after high school to the man she was betrothed to as a child. But that man has other dreams. So her parents try to arrange another marriage. This time the chosen groom is the son of another mafia boss. At first, Mantou refuses since she feels nothing for Brian, not knowing that he has had a crush on her since they were children. However, Brian strives to win her love in the midst of jealousy, misunderstandings and a potentially devastating battle between Thailand's three major Mafia families.

name: Cat Radio TV
summary: A lively comedy of a small music station called Cat Radio. Jong is the producer as well as the head of the radio station. His teammates Boom, a female producer; Gig, an accountant; War, a confident salesperson; and Pleng, a mysterious girl who brings surprises to the Cat team, together with many others who come along to this radio station.

name: Les Pennac(s)
summary: When a father and daughter reconnect through solving police investigations, it's not going to be easy!

name: The Secret Spy Affair
summary: When duty meets desire, trust is the deadliest game. Former top agent Daniel Holt thought he had retired from the world of espionage—until a mission unlike any before pulls him back in. His task: protect Lily Derikson, the rebellious daughter of a powerful general, during what should have been a quiet vacation. But when a terrorist plot engulfs their island hotel, Daniel is forced to rely on old instincts and navigate dangerous secrets, including those from his seductive ex-partner, Michelle. As bullets fly and betrayals mount, Daniel must decide if he can still be a spy… and finally become a man worth loving.

name: The Mafia Boss
summary: Undercover cop Talia gets dangerously close to notorious mafia boss Luciano, aiming to bring him down. But what begins as a carefully orchestrated mission soon spirals into a high-stakes game of deception, passion, and betrayal. As Talia navigates a web of secrets and criminal underworld politics, she must decide how far she's willing to go to maintain her cover—and whether her feelings for Luciano are genuine or just another part of the ruse. With their lives on the line, the question remains: can love survive in a world where trust is a weapon?

name: One Night Stand With My Boyfriend's Brother
summary: One Night Stand is a gripping and emotionally charged drama about love, betrayal, and the fight for survival. When picture-perfect housewife Mackenzie Exford is diagnosed with terminal cancer, her world spirals into chaos—her marriage to a power-hungry politician crumbles, and her last hope becomes an impulsive encounter with a mysterious ex-con, Chase. What begins as a reckless escape soon turns into a powerful bond that challenges the lies around her. But in a world where image is everything and power corrupts absolutely, Mackenzie must navigate a web of deceit, media manipulation, and political ambition to reclaim her life—if she can survive it.

name: Dalziel and Pascoe
summary:
The series centres on the relationship between seasoned Detective Inspector Andrea Dalziel and the newly qualified, by the book perfectionist Detective Sergeant Paige Pascoe.

Despite their clashing methods, Dalziel and Pascoe work together to form a formidable partnership that is underscored by humour, heart and humanity.

name: The White House
summary: Power, rivalry, scandal, and war engulf three U.S. presidents and two first ladies, shaping a nation within the newly built White House.

name: Back to Your Youth
summary: Yan Ran's arranged marriage ended in heartbreak when her husband, Chen Sui, died in a car accident, leaving behind only a secret diary. By a twist of fate, Yan Ran travels back to the past and saves the younger Chen Sui. She chooses to stay by his side, protecting him and helping him escape the darkness surrounding his life. After enduring separation and growing through countless hardships, the two finally uncover the deep love they have carried for each other across two lifetimes.

name: Etty
summary: In Nazi-occupied Amsterdam, twenty-sevenyear- old Jewish Etty Hillesum begins therapy. What starts as personal exploration becomes a spiritual awakening, documented in her diaries. Guided by psycho-chirologist Julius Spier, her mentor and lover, she undergoes a radical inner transformation. She'll discover that even when all is taken, one can remain free within.

name: Gang Kao Kayao Krua
summary: Boss is a young man in his 20s who just quit his job. He inherited a small restaurant from his father who recently passed away. It's a good opportunity for Boss to change from a salaryman to the owner of something, just like he dreamed of. But the reality is not as beautiful as the dream. The employees in the store are elders who have worked there since the days when Boss's father had just opened it. Boss wanted to sell the store, but he finally decides to keep it when a old man who he thought was a problem turned out to be the one who made him learn many things that are important to life.

name: 100 Jahre Neues Bauen
summary: Bright, airy, and affordable. Idealistic architects of the 1920s wanted to transform living conditions with decent affordable housing for all. In Germany, it was under the banner of Neues Bauen (New Objectivity), as cramped, filthy tenements were replaced with functional, hygienic, and comfortable homes. This series sees how these pioneering architects changed urban living in Frankfurt and Berlin, but also in Vienna and Bordeaux.

name: Entrelacés
summary: The series explores the different stages of a romantic relationship (honeymoon, power struggle, doubt, true love, and break-up) through the story of a central couple, Michel and Marie, which is mirrored in vignettes of other couples in each episode.

name: Lights Out
summary: Lights Out follows trauma nurse Aly, whose dark fantasy comes true when a masked vigilante hacker, Josh, breaks into her house, leading to a steamy, dangerous romance where the lines between desire, obsession, and reality start to blur.

name: Boys of Tommen
summary: Boys of Tommen follows the forbidden love story of Johnny Kavanagh, the star rugby player on the verge of a pro career, and Shannon Lynch, the talented but painfully shy new girl at the prestigious Tommen College in Ballylaggin, Ireland. Both teens are hiding secrets; Johnny, a potentially devastating injury and Shannon, a troubled and violent homelife.

name: Les armes secrètes de Poutine
summary: The Russian army has still got plenty of weapons despite sanctions: With a stockpile of Soviet-era weapons and newly produced modern hypersonic weapons, the country could strike Europe within minutes. An opaque network of spies, shell companies and oligarchs ensures its ability to wage war - through arms trading, technology theft and state-directed terror.

name: TikTok, un réseau sous influence
summary: TikTok is a hugely popular and controversial social media platform. But is the most downloaded app in the world working for the Chinese government?  Two-part investigation into TikTok and the data war that is being waged between world powers.

name: L'odyssée des chiffres
summary: A fabulous history of numbers and civilizations faced with the infinite need to count, measure and calculate

name: Der weiße Hass
summary: Far-right terrorism has grown more organized since the late 1900s, with rising casualties worldwide. Through global testimonies from victims, former extremists, and investigators, we explore its spread and potential solutions.

name: Vietnam. Geburt einer Nation
summary: Under French colonial rule, Vietnam was not an independent state, but part of Indochina. The emotional recounts of the journey of a nation that experienced utopias, conflicts, and the horrors of the late 20th century.

name: Coração Acelerado
summary: This romantic musical comedy tells the story of Agrado Garcia, who dreams of becoming a successful country music singer. Along the way, she reunites with the star João Raul, her former love.

name: Emergência Radioativa
summary: Emergência Radioativa is inspired by a real-life Cesium-137 accident. The series begins when a radiotherapy device is opened at a scrapyard, releasing radioactive material that spreads through Goiânia. A race against time follows, as the authorities and specialists work to track the contamination and save lives, including those of an entire family affected by the tragedy. The drama shines a light on the anonymous heroes whose efforts mobilised the country and brought renewed attention to the work of Brazilian scientists and medical teams.

name: La Vraie Vie
summary: Victor Assié is a young actor who begins to question the purpose of his work. Directors Ekiem Barbier and Guilhem Causse give him an unusual assignment: to inhabit a virtual avatar and explore an online life simulation-an apparently familiar yet subtly disordered world. In this digital realm, Victor must start from scratch: get a driver's license, buy a car, find a job... but nothing is quite what it seems. As he navigates this strange but eerily real simulation, Victor's journey becomes both absurd and profound, blending humor, doubt, and revelation. Across five episodes, La Vraie Vie probes our relationship to reality and how identity adapts when life and simulation intersect.

name: Les femmes riches ne courent pas les rues
summary: This investigation lifts the veil on the financial situation of women in Western countries supposedly more advanced than those of the South in terms of rights. A systemic reality of wealth and income gaps between the sexes.

name: La fabuleuse histoire de l'argent
summary: Gold, silver, bronze or paper: money tells the story of 2,700 years of human history. An essential tool for trade and a symbol of power, it fuelled the expansion of empires and changed the course of civilisations. From ancient cowrie shells to the rise of the first banknotes and cryptocurrencies, this four-part series uncovers the role of money in history.

name: La Fabrique du Mensonge
summary: How is fake news born and spread? Who are the instigators and how have those who have been targeted fight against them?

previousepisode.name: Elon Musk : la conquête du pouvoir en 80 000 tweets

name: The Poetry of Reality with Richard Dawkins
summary: The Poetry of Reality is hosted by world renowned truth-teller, evolutionary biologist and best-selling author, Professor Richard Dawkins. An audio and video experience that tracks our acclaimed protagonist in his navigation of the natural world and his pursuit of truth through scientific curiosity.

previousepisode.name: Think For Yourself: Breaking Out Of Indoctrination

name: Julia Bradbury's Wonders of the Frozen South
summary:
Julia Bradbury's Wonders of the Frozen South follows Julia Bradbury on a remarkable 23-day expedition itinerary through the Southern Ocean, travelling to some of the world's most remote and awe-inspiring regions, including the Falkland Islands, South Georgia and Antarctica.

Sailing aboard HX Expeditions' purpose-built expedition ship MS Fram, Julia journeys from the tip of South America, encountering dramatic landscapes, rare wildlife and resilient communities shaped by one of Earth's harshest environments.

Each episode focuses on a distinct destination, with the first episode set in the Falkland Islands, the second travelling to the wildlife-rich island of South Georgia, and the final episode culminating in Antarctica itself.

From vast ice fields and towering glaciers to windswept coastlines and polar seas, Julia explores the wildlife and delicate ecosystems of these regions, learning from the scientists and specialists dedicated to understanding and protecting these extreme environments.

name: Made For March
summary: Made For March profiles Powerhouse Programs Michigan and Kansas with Exclusive Access Through The 2026 College Basketball Season and Tournament.

name: Strategic Partner
summary: Forced out of her former company, Jiang Lai rises by sheer resilience and talent at Wen Group, earning respect, power, and a profound bond of trust with CEO Wen Jingran. Yet just as she reaches new heights, shadows of the past and a crossroads of the heart silently emerge.

name: Cong Zhui Xu Dao Chong Chen
Skegness Psycho: 28 Miles To Murder
summary: Just before midnight in May 2021, violent criminal Daniel Boulton leaves his hostel in Skegness and begins a 28-mile march to the home his ex-girlfriend, Bethany Vincent, shares with her two young sons. Bethany's family tell the story of how this loving mother-of-two started a relationship with Daniel Boulton with no idea of his violent past. There is a further tragedy in this case, revealed by retired homicide detective Russell Wate. His investigations reveal that parole officers, the police, health services and other agencies were aware of Boulton's past and deteriorating behaviour – but failures in multi-agency communication and risk management meant they were unable to keep Bethany and DJ safe.

name: The Tony Blair Story
summary: Tony Blair is one of Britain's most successful and controversial leaders. With unprecedented access, including Blair and family, this series charts his meteoric rise to power. And what happened next.

name: Fukushima: Days That Shocked The World
summary: Survivors and witnesses recall March 11 2011 - when Japan was hit by a devastating tsunami of 40-foot waves, killing 20,000 and triggering a nuclear meltdown.

name: The Rockford Files
summary: Newly paroled after doing time for a crime he didn't commit, James Rockford returns to his life as a private investigator using his charm and wit to solve cases around Los Angeles. It doesn't take long for his quest for legitimacy to land him squarely in the crosshairs of both local police and organized crime.

name: The Siege
summary: 30th April 1980. Six armed Arab Iranian separatists burst into the Iranian embassy in London, taking hostage the 26 people inside, demanding autonomy for their people. Over the next six days, the gunmen, the hostages and the police struggled with each other for control of the situation while the soldiers of the SAS mounted plans for a daring mission to break the siege that would be witnessed by the watching world.

name: Chentang Genesis: Love in Fallen City
summary: After a sudden time slip to Shang-era Chentang Pass, Yin Yuhan finds herself stranded, and reunited with her destined husband, Li Jing. Together they defend the garrison against an invasion from the sea. With her modern ingenuity, she uncovers a hidden conspiracy, locates an ancient artifact, and arms the defense with gunpowder. In the final clash, she gives her life to save countless others, only to be reborn through the Vermilion Bird's fiery grace. Yin and Li prevail. Peace is restored. But deep beneath the waves, a new threat awakens…

name: All Mothers Lie
summary: Eli, a single mother, spends her life in front of the TV with Itamar, her 13-year-old son, but a warning call from his teacher reveals to her that his greatest ambition is to do exactly like her, nothing. To model normalcy for him, she is dragged into a failed Newcomb+ team of mothers, and there, amidst falls, lies, fights and casual loves, they manage to wake up to life together. If that's not enough, after years without a relationship or sex, Eli finds herself falling deeply in love with Yigal, the team's coach and her lover from twenty years ago.

name: Dot Conner: Webtective
summary: Dot Conner is the world's first "webtective," a detective who uses the internet to solve mysteries, and in Dot's experience there are no bigger mysteries than the questions she has about her Christian faith. With the help of her best friends, Dot pursues answers to her questions like a detective on a criminal case. Her investigations often lead her to interviews with experts in all sorts of fields who help her not only understand the complex questions of faith but also how to apply biblical truth to her own life.

name: Conviction
summary: Conviction centers on criminal Defense Attorney Neve Harper, a confident lawyer who finally has her shot at a career-making case: a high-profile murder where the husband is accused of killing his wife by setting their home on fire. But when a mysterious stranger begins blackmailing Neve, she is forced to compromise every legal, moral and ethical obligation to gain an acquittal — or else risk her dark secrets being exposed.

name: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro
summary: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro features up-and-coming professional dancers who live in a house together and compete in a grueling audition process. The winner will land a coveted spot as a pro dancer on the next season of Dancing with the Stars.

previousepisode.name: The Final Step: Finale with Derek Hough and Witney Carson

name: Phoenix
summary: As the bosses of Europe's biggest companies launch a forum in the Alps to fight global warming and save a glacier, the Phoenix Group is taking action: across the continent, these six young activists are simultaneously kidnapping the children of leaders. Their goal: to denounce their greenwashing and force them to keep their promises before it is too late.

name: Ni Hao Da Dan Zhi Shei Shi Wo Di
Predator Hunters
summary: Predator Hunters, following 30-year veteran investigator Detective Tony Godwin and his team within the North Texas-based Internet Crimes Against Children (ICAC) Task Force as they uncover online exploitation and bring perpetrators to justice before they harm any children. The series provides first-hand access to real investigations as Godwin - who has partnered with the FBI, Homeland Security, and the U.S. Secret Service - opens his case files for the first time.

previousepisode.name: Caught in a Web of Lies

name: Oh Thai Girl! Pull at the General's heartstrings
BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!: 5th Anniversary Animation - CiRCLE Thanks Party!
summary: A two-episode 2022 anime special celebrating the 5th anniversary of the BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! mobile game. It follows all 35 main characters across 7 bands as they prepare for a thank-you event at CiRCLE live house, culminating in a joint performance of a new song.

name: The Unknowable: Darkland
summary: The Unknowable explores the complex characters and supernatural forces behind the mysterious disappearances linked to the Darkland Amusement Park.

name: YU-NO
summary:
Takuya's father died during an accident while he was doing research. Worried about his young stepmother, Ayumi, Takuya follows her to Ken point. Watching her and her best friend, Mitsuki, from behind a rock, a sudden flash of light turns into an unearthly beautiful woman. The mysterious woman slips a ring on his finger, and Takuya's travels into a parallel world begins.

This ring is the key between Takuya and his different realities.

This is original OVA series based on video-game with the same title.

previousepisode.name: The Goddess Sings at the Edge of the World

name: Free Willy
summary: Teenager Jesse reunites with his orca friend Willy at a marine rescue center, where he discovers the ability to communicate with marine life. Together with other ocean creatures, they fight against a robotic villain, The Machine, who seeks to destroy the ocean environment.

name: Birodalom
summary: Birodalom (Empire) is a new fiction series from the creators of The King, which draws inspiration from the adult film world of the nineties, but focuses not on behind-the-scenes sensationalism, but on human destinies and decisions.

name: Патриаршие умы
summary: Four comedians are fighting a pseudo-intellectual battle against the girls from Patrick's. The goal of the comedians is not to give the correct answer to the question, but to guess what the girls answered. The presenter is Nikita Andrienko.

name: Разыграли
summary: "Played" is a show in which the stars fall into perfectly planned practical jokes from Khetag Khugaev. There is an "accomplice" in each issue. The person who helps the presenter to lure the star. And the "target" is the star that is being played. And the output is a cool and funny prank!

previousepisode.name: #8 | Илья Куруч, Илья Сатир, Хетаг Хугаев

name: Медиафутбол. История одного прикола
summary:
"Media football. The Story of a Joke" is a two–part film about one of the most popular and daring phenomena in Russian sports. The main characters of the industry talk about the path from FIFA to the largest stadiums in the country, the debut in professional football and the transformation of a crowd of bloggers into full-fledged clubs with coaching staff, contracts and fees.

But building a new industry from scratch cannot be smooth. The league and the teams are facing a backlash from big-time football, and conflicts are raging within the community.

previousepisode.name: We have to overtake some people

name: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
summary: Takuya Seo is a quiet otaku who keeps a low profile at school—until two gals from his class start talking to him. The cool but scatterbrained Kei Amane and the cheerful, energetic Kotoko Ijichi couldn't be more different, but the three soon bond over anime, games, and shared fandom. But one question remains: do nice gals who hang out with otaku really exist?!

name: Clock It with Symone & Eugene
summary: Symone Sanders Townsend and Eugene Daniels were once at odds as White House staffer and White House reporter. Now they're friends and colleagues–each co-hosting their own shows at MS NOW. But their off-air conversations are where the real action is. Their new show, "MS NOW Presents: Clock It" is an invitation to their groupchat, the liveliest—and most informative—out there. Whether it's ICE getting dispatched to the Super Bowl because Bad Bunny's doing the halftime show, or Nicolás Maduro's Nike Tech fit, or Michael B. Jordan's sole Oscar nomination despite playing three roles in Sinners, there is no collision between culture and politics that this show won't document and decipher. Symone and Eugene see exactly what's going on—and they want you to clock it, too.

previousepisode.name: Kash Patel, Gavin Newsom, and a Very "Raggedy" Black History Month

name: Single's Inferno Reunion
summary: "Single's Inferno" contestants reunite to reveal honest feelings and relationship updates — revisiting standout moments from their time on the island.

name: Comedy Now!
summary: Comedy Now! is a Canadian stand-up comedy series spanning more than 20 years that helped pave the way for numerous Canadian writer/comedians.

name: Yuusha, Yamemasu: Kenshuu Ryokou wa Mokuteki wo Miushinau na
summary: A two-part new animation released with both Blu-ray/DVD boxes.

previousepisode.name: The Work Trip Is First and Foremost a Learning Opportunity (Part Two)

name: Nazis: Threads of Evil
summary: In the beer halls of post war Germany, Adolf Hitler, seizes the moment and captivates a nation desperate for a saviour. A group forms, made of sycophants, enablers and opportunists, that will become some of history's most notorious perpetrators.

name: Ple Ple Pleiades: Fugitive Clementine
summary:
Hikari TV original side-story from Ple Ple Pleiades parody series on Overlord anime.

After being revived, Clementine lives undercover as a fugitive. She tries to leave the Kingdom so that she does not get caught by Ainz again. But luck would have it otherwise, as she keeps running into the battle maids.

name: Me Declaro Culpable
summary:
Franco Urzúa is a prestigious lawyer with an extended and successful career. He is married to Roberta, a beautiful and wealthy woman who is tormented by the bipolar disorder she has suffered since childhood. Franco and Roberta have a daughter, Natalia, who is Franco's most precious jewel.
 

Despite all his success, money and fame, Franco's life is empty. His marriage with Roberta has fallen into routine and turned into a loveless relationship; nevertheless, it is hard for him to consider divorce as an option since he is part of the prestigious law firm owned by his father in-law, Mauro, whom he worships and truly cares for.

Life brings Franco face to face with the hardest and most challenging of trials: defending Alba Garza, a devoted and loving wife who got her husband disconnected from the life-support equipment that kept him alive as he was terminally ill. But losing her freedom is the price she will pay for her choice. Desperate to see her son Santiago again and with no money to pay herself a lawyer, Alba begs Franco to help her. He gets moved by her story and accepts taking her case. Thanks to his talent and deep knowledge of law, Franco has Alba released on parole. 

Upon leaving jail, Alba tries to recover her son and take him away from Ingrid, her sister in-law who assumed the legal responsibility for Alba's son and hates her for ending her brother's life. Alba fights hard to recover her son, but Ingrid tries to prevent her from achieving it at all costs, even getting a restraining order. With Franco's help, Alba wins each and every one of the battles against Ingrid and finally she can approach her son again and start rebuilding a relationship with him.

Alba and Franco start getting in touch too often, and although the circumstances around them are adverse, their frequent coexistence leads them to inevitably fall in love with each other.

But a woman whose heart has been broken is capable of anything, and more so if she suffers a mental illness, that´s why Roberta won't give up her husband so easily. She will dare to do the unthinkable just to keep him with her.

On the other hand, Natalia, Franco and Roberta's daughter, is a nice girl with a good moral. She is Julián's girlfriend, a man who is with her out of convenience.

Natalia's life changes radically after she runs over a man. She wants to take responsibility for her action and tell her father about it, but Julián and Roberta stop her from doing so, arguing he would be sorely disappointed by this. Fearful, Natalia remains silent and tormented by the guilt about what happened, ignoring that Paolo, the boy with whom she falls madly in love, is in fact the guy she hit with her car.

All the same, Franco will remain a strong man of faith, determination, and persistence, who won't stop until he gives Alba her freedom back and brings his own heart to life, fighting for his new love and her cause.

Paolo and Natalia will prove that hatred and love are both part of the same scale and it is up to them to shift it to their side.

Love, hatred, manipulation, and lies will make this story unique, proving that each one of us are responsible for our own fate.

name: The investigation
summary: In The Investigation, RP Kahl examines Peter Weiss' documentary play, which deals with the Frankfurt Auschwitz trials of the 1960s. The play, originally conceived as a literary chronicle of the court proceedings, served as the basis for Kahl's minimalist film adaptation, which retains the text in its structural rigor and reinterprets it through cinematic means.

name: Bodyline
summary: Dramatization of the 1932/33 Test cricket series between England and Australia. Played in Australia, the series gained notoriety in Australian and worldwide cricketing history for the fact that the English team (headed by captain Douglas Jardine) applied a bowling technique called "leg theory", or more commonly, Bodyline. This technique involved bowlers bowling the ball directly at the batsman's body, and resulted in many of the Australian team receiving numerous bruises and injuries, with batsman Bert Oldfield sustaining a cracked skull. The series generated much anger and resentment towards the English team within Australia and seriously damaged Anglo-Australian cricketing relations at the time.

name: БЕЗ ПРАВ НА ОШИБКУ
summary: Olya Parfenyuk and Denis Mikheev decided to try to understand why some famous people do not drive a car. Have fun and learn how to drive in the new show "Without the right to make mistakes."

name: МУЖИЦКИЙ ВЕЧЕР
summary: What is a peasant evening and what dishes do the representatives of the stronger sex indulge themselves with? The answer to this question is given from the very first issue. The initiator of the meeting goes to the store with his friends to buy the necessary products. After that, the guys, loaded with packages, return to the log country house, where the fun begins.

name: ОБОЙМА
summary: Famous guests get to know the world of firearms in a light, dynamic and at the same time safe format. They will be immersed in the basics of handling pistols and rifles, followed by practical target shooting, which requires concentration and self-control. The learning process is accompanied by live communication, jokes and excitement, turning the training into a real show. Not only accuracy and technique are important here, but also the ability to cope with excitement, listen carefully to instructions and work on mistakes. Shooting can be an exciting experience if you approach it responsibly and with the right mindset.

previousepisode.name: #3 Гурбанов, Богадовка, Тарас Пушка, Кама, Карабин ROSSI 92

name: ГДЕ САНЯ?! ОСЕННЯЯ ОХОТА
summary: Sanya will tell you about the autumn hunting.

name: ТЕСТ НА МУЖИКА
summary: A show in which guests are tested for knowledge of real men's activities for three rounds, and at the end of the superfinal, where they compete in a practical task, a real man is determined.

name: МУЖСКАЯ ТЕРАПИЯ
summary: Men's Therapy is a show in which Dmitry Pozov, Egor Svirsky and professional psychologist Mark Barton, in the company of a guest, discuss modern men's problems in various spheres of life.

name: Видеоблог «Тур Гурам Амарян и друзья»
summary:
Video blog from the stand-up tour "Guram Amaryan and friends". 
Guram Amaryan, Ilya Rayevsky, Vadim Postilny, Ernest Tarzhumanyan, Gevorg Abrahamyan and Sergey Snurnikov are touring Russia with concerts.

name: Nuls en chef
summary: In Nuls en chef, 12 celebrities with no culinary talent attempt recipes for the first time under the watchful eye of Arnaud Soly. Guided by chef John Mike, they learn the basics of cooking and have their dishes evaluated to help them improve.

name: Please! Einzbern Counseling Room
summary:
Join Irisviel as she helps Disciple No. Zero understand more details and history relating to the Holy Grail War.

These specials are included in the blu-ray box sets I & II.

name: Laundry Romance
summary: Life, like clothes, sometimes gets wrinkled and shriveled. Jae Min, a 30-year-old job seeker who lives with anxiety that clings to him like grime, and Ji Seok, a 34-year-old voluntary unemployed person who threw away his well-ironed shirt and chose to stop. A healing romance between two men that blends in with the noise of the washing machines running late at night at a coin laundromat.

name: Always Meet Again
summary: Everyone has imagined it at least once. What if you could go back to the past? Jang Hye Seong, a well-known painter, visits his alma mater, Seongjin High School, to give a special lecture at the request of his friend Tae Jun. During a break, he stops by the art room and discovers his old sketchbook. Inside it, he finds a drawing of his first love, Lee U Jin, half undressed. On impulse, Hye Seong redraws U Jin right there. The moment he finishes the painting and puts the brush down, he is suddenly transported back to 2008, his high school days, where he reunites with U Jin. Even after returning, Hye Seong doesn't want to repeat the mistakes he made back then, so he tries to keep his distance from U Jin. But with U Jin boldly and persistently coming closer, Hye Seong is left completely defenseless. Their eighteen begins again. Can they change their fate and finally reach each other?

name: Blessed by the Baby God of Wealth
Father Kneels to Beg Mercy, I Ruin His Life!
Wo Xie Wan Zong Ta Long Que
Les aventures de Saturnin
summary: This series features the adventures of a cantankerous duck, Saturnin, and his companions (the police dog, foxes, marmots, cat, goat, Professor Popof, Jeannot Rabbit, Lady Weasel...) in their village where animals can, for example, drive cars, eat at the table, live comfortably, garden or even go skiing. Saturnin is also a secret agent who foils the plans of a weasel or ferret.

name: Ron
summary: The amusing adventures of Ron, the unemployed bachelor living in a crumbling apartment. He's 36 now, and his uneventful way of life is getting to him. Could he break out of his old habits and have a chance of happiness.

name: Les Moissons de l'océan
summary: The story takes place in the 1960s and follows Manu, a young fisherman from Saint-Jean-de-Luz who experiments with a new fishing technique, attracting the hostility of a wealthy couple.

name: Le Fils du cordonnier
summary: Set in Brittany at the beginning of the 20th century, it follows the life of Pierre, the son of a poor shoemaker named Célestin. Due to extreme poverty, Pierre is sent away to be raised by nuns and later by harsh foster parents on a farm.

name: Seher hone ko hai
summary: Strong-willed Kausar defies societal barriers for her daughter Seher's big dreams, but will destiny stand by their side?

name: The Rise
summary: Inside the season that finally gave the league the spotlight it deserves, through thrilling game footage and exclusive interviews with the athletes.

previousepisode.name: The Inaugural Season of the PWHL

name: Locker Diaries: ZOMBIES
summary: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Shadyside & Sunnyside and discover the secret adventures that unfold.

name: Tonight At The Museum
summary: Filmed on location in a real museum after dark, surrounded by priceless artefacts, taxidermy and historical curiosities, Alex Lee guides four celebrity players through a series of challenges and quizzes that deliver gags quick and fast.

name: Dirty Laundry Live
summary: On Dirty Laundry Live, Lawrence Mooney and his panel of celebrity guests will pull apart the major pop culture stories of the week in an unpredictable, irreverent and unscripted live-to-air quiz show, where anything could happen. Whether you're a trashmag subscriber, a celebrity blog addict or just a doctor's waiting room time-passer, join Lawrence and his guests each week as they chew up and spit out all the celebrity trash and glamour they can manage.

name: Killer on the Run
summary: True-crime series focusing on the hunt for elusive killers.

previousepisode.name: When Evil Calls: Larry Gene Bell

name: Седьмой игрок
summary:
"Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.

The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.

name: Ed Stafford's Rite of Passage
summary: Adventurer Ed Stafford courses the world to experience how indigenous peoples turn boys into men.

name: Mahouka for Dummies!
summary:
Mahouka for Dummies is a set of seven shorts that introduce the basics behind Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei anime. Chibi versions of the characters explain the world of Mahouka in a classroom setting. The first three were shown before the Anime was aired, while the fourth was shown during the Nine Schools Competition Arc, and the fifth and sixth during the Yokohama Disturbance Arc. A seventh was included later with the DVD release.

Episodes 1-6 were posted on the official website, while episode 7 was later included on the disc release.

name: Nicholas Rossi: Predator on Trial
summary: December 2021, a man with Covid wakes up from a coma in a Glasgow hospital surrounded by detectives. They say he is Nicholas Rossi, one of America's most wanted fugitives. He claims to be a disabled academic called Arthur Knight. This is the astonishing story of one of the world's most dangerous conmen and the transatlantic battle for justice.

name: Two Weeks in August
summary:
Set in Greece, Two Weeks in August tells the story of a woman who goes on holiday with her family and friends to rediscover joy in her life. But here in paradise, what starts with an illicit kiss, quickly turns the dream holiday into a nightmare. Zoe begins to act on her deepest desires and the holiday she hoped for becomes a reckoning for a group of adults who refuse to grow up.

When they discover they are trapped on the island, and become faced with real life-or-death situations, the group soon turn on each other to find out who is to blame. Is Zoe responsible for the drama and destruction around her or, as heaven turns to hell, are bigger forces at play? We are in Greece after all, the land of the ancient Gods…

name: Солдат по кличке Рекс
summary:
Autumn 1943. An enemy shepherd dog attacks a Soviet reconnaissance group during a sortie. Defending themselves, the soldiers open fire, giving away their location and coming under mortar fire. Having narrowly escaped death, the head of the Gromov reconnaissance group takes the injured dog with him and asks the surgeon to perform surgery on her and save the animal. 

When the dog recovers, Gromov is going to reform him and unsuccessfully tries to establish contact with him. Corporal Miroshnikov helps the hero find a common language with the dog. Soon, thanks to kindness and ingenuity, he manages to turn the dog into an assistant who is ready to go with him on exploration and perform difficult tasks. But one day Gromov meets the former owner of Rex, who tries to force the dog to remember old habits and commands.…

name: Fame to Table: With Matthew Hoffman
summary: In Fame to Table join Television Host Matthew Hoffman, as he interviews famous chefs about the dish that made them famous - peeling back the apron one delicious and distinguished dish at a time.

name: Kung Fu Masters of the Zodiac
Girltrash!
summary: Set in the criminal underworld of Los Angeles with a dark but over the top Miami Vice vibe, Girltrash! follows the story of five ass-kicking girls, getting by any way they can, even if it means double crossing your best friend or former lover.

name: Wild Boys: Strangers in Town
summary: In 2003, two young men emerge from the forests of British Columbia claiming to have been raised entirely off the grid. As a small town tries to help them, a mystery unfolds, testing how far people will go to believe the unbelievable.

name: Александр Македонский
summary:
In October 1994, lawyer Valery Karyshev received a client, whose name, according to the terms of the contract, must be kept secret. This man is the legendary killer Alexander Solonik, who received the nickname "Macedonian" for his ability to shoot simultaneously with two hands. Solonik, who was wounded in a shootout with police officers, is placed in a special unit of the Matrosskaya Tishina detention center. Upon learning that the killer has already made two successful escapes from the courtroom and from the zone, the jailers transfer him to solitary confinement.

For the murder of policemen and thieves in law, the killer faces, in addition to a court sentence, two more unofficial, death sentences - from comrades of the deceased policemen and from the mafia. Realizing that death cannot be avoided, Solonik plans an escape, in which his masters, former generals of the special services, must help him.

name: Холостяк
summary:
To catch the drug dealer Brown, an experienced Moscow operative, Zverev, is called to Odessa. His goal is to infiltrate the gang. A confirmed bachelor, he must come with his wife and son for the authenticity of the legend.

The charming Masha Yakovleva, an employee of the archive of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the widow of a police captain, was chosen for the role of his wife. Her son Pavlik is supposed to play Zverev's son. Everything is not going according to plan in this risky business from the very beginning.

name: Melodies of Life: My Name is Single
summary: On New Years Eve, three young people become single at the same time. Cho is an artist and owner of a silk screen printing business who's shocked when a surprise marriage proposal goes south. Timor, Cho's close friend since high school, gets her heart broken that same day when her western boyfriend breaks up with her instead of proposing as she'd imagined. Cho's nerdy younger brother Saiya discovers that the sexy woman he's been chatting with online for so long never truly existed; it was just a prank his friends were playing on him. All three of them are single in a flash like lightning. The hi-so widow Yves Saint, Cho's office landlord, has to cheer the three up. She promises a big reward to the person who can find a new partner before the end of the year.

name: Todd Sampson's Why?
summary: Todd Sampson explores the intriguing complexities of human behaviour, driven by a curiosity to unravel the mysteries behind our actions. Each episode embarks on a quest to understand the things people do.

name: Australia's Greatest Conman?
summary:
Marc Fennell sets out to uncover the truth behind John Friedrich, the man who deceived a nation. He reveals a story that's stranger than fiction, delving into a web of lies and money.

In the 1980s, John Friedrich ran an elite sea and land rescue squad in Victoria, winning an Order of Australia, top-secret government contracts and hundreds of millions of dollars in loans.

But no one knew that John Friedrich was not who he made out to be. His undoing revealed one of the most audacious scams in Australian history, worth an estimated $900 million in today's money.

name: Твой дом
summary:
Yusup dreamed of becoming a movie star and blogger, but he is turning into a star of the trading floor.

A loser actor uses a fake resume and, thanks to chance, becomes the director of a huge hypermarket!  His methods are outrageous, but damn effective. Now the hypermarket is plunging into an absurd mockumentary reality, where the aroma of barbecue at the checkout and non-standard promotions "blow up" sales and the lives of employees.

Unsurpassed Yusup Omarov in the new series, in the role of ex-actor and CEO Yusup Sakhratulaevich.

name: ВЛОГ IMPROV.МИНСК
summary:
The "Minskys" are in the ground!

At the end of 2024, Improv Minsk — Sergey Shevelev, Maxim Zayats, Sergey Gorokh, Artyom Gaus — went on tour with their exclusive improvisational show.

Tyumen, Omsk, Samara, Krasnoyarsk, Novosibirsk, Yekaterinburg, St. Petersburg and Moscow are the cities that the boys visited as part of the autumn tour.

For information about how the concerts went and what happened to
the improvisers between performances, see the exclusive VK Video in the blog.

name: Проверятор
summary:
The year is 2045. Life on the planet is almost destroyed. Robots run everything. The remnants of civilization are being destroyed by ruthless cyborg Inspectors.

The survivors decide to send one Checker back in time to prevent the creation of an evil Supercomputer responsible for the apocalypse. He must find Anton Pronin, the future leader of the Resistance, and now an honest employee of Roskontrolnadzor. But the Examiner needs to hurry, because the Chosen One is about to die.

name: Свежая Россия
summary:
Tradition is alive as long as it is able to change. And items created with traditional motifs allow you to talk to customers.

These principles are followed by small brands from national republics. They create unique collections, conveying through them the cultural code and the spirit of the people. And more and more people want to enter into a so-called dialogue with them.

In the Fresh Russia project, we will tell you how local products win the hearts of Russians.

previousepisode.name: Как бренды из национальных республик подсадили всю Россию на свои украшения

name: Попавшие в сети
summary:
A person in a difficult life situation is an ideal victim for a recruiter.

Desperate from financial problems, people easily succumb to manipulation and persuasion if they are promised to earn extra money. Moreover, at first they are given very simple tasks: to post a post, to put up ads. The euphoria of easy earnings, along with the techniques of social engineering from scammers, do not allow you to come to your senses and "get off the hook." But instead of solving problems, a person gets difficulties with the law and a real sentence for vandalism or terrorism.

"The ribbon.<url> has studied how recruiters work and who becomes their victims.

previousepisode.name: Как мошенники подчиняют себе людей и похищают у них гигантские суммы

name: Без срока давности. Правда о нацизме
summary:
80 years ago, the Nuremberg trials began — the main world trial of the criminals of Nazi Germany.

As a result, 12 of the main actors of the war were sentenced to death, while others received large and even life sentences. It seemed that the crimes of Nazism were in the distant past. But time has shown that Nazism is as tenacious as a terrible virus.

"The ribbon.<url>" and the National Center for Historical Memory under the President of the Russian Federation begin a cycle of materials for the project "Without a statute of limitations. The truth about Nazism", which will tell about the crimes of Nazi Germany.

name: Право на вторжение
summary: For more than two years, the West has been criticizing Russia for the special military operation launched in February 2022 in Ukraine. However, over the past 50 years, the United States and its allies have repeatedly invaded the territories of sovereign states that posed no threat to them in the name of their political and economic interests. Citizens of Guatemala, Serbia, Iraq, and Afghanistan well remember the full-scale military interventions that plunged their countries into chaos, led to numerous civilian casualties, and destroyed the economy. Most of these conflicts were unleashed under far-fetched pretexts and without the approval of the UN Security Council. That is why most developing countries have not sided with the United States and its allies in condemning Russia, considering the claims of Western elites who put their interests above international norms and stop at nothing to protect them to be untenable.

previousepisode.name: Как страны НАТО свергли Каддафи и превратили Ливию в базу для террористов со всего мира

name: Жизнь замечательных людей
summary:
These people have changed the world we live in. Geniuses, creators and daredevils. Their actions influenced the destinies of millions, their discoveries and decisions turned the idea of human capabilities upside down. They were ahead of their time, admired and became the idols of generations.

And each of them has an incredible life.

previousepisode.name: Кто такой Анастас Микоян и как он накормил Советский Союз

name: ONnOFF
summary: These intense gazes, this tension... you're really telling me there's nothing between them? The subtle undercurrent flowing between them creates breathtaking suspense! Colleagues? Rivals? Lovers? The boundaries are becoming blurred.

previousepisode.name: 11 people go! !! Sounding big family song

name: Scooby-Doo: Origins
summary: Scooby-Doo: Origins is a modern reimagining of the iconic mystery-solving group of teens and their very special dog. During their final summer at camp, old friends Shaggy and Daphne get embroiled in a haunting mystery surrounding a lonely lost Great Dane puppy that may have been a witness to a supernatural murder. Together with the pragmatic and scientific townie, Velma, and the strange, but ever so handsome new kid, Freddy, they set out to solve the case that is pulling each of them into a creepy nightmare that threatens to expose all of their secrets.

name: Bil Haram
summary: When tragedy strikes her traveling theatre troupe, Joud must face a scarred past and an unjust present—where loss, justice, and hope collide as she uncovers a truth more perilous than imagined.

name: My Two Cars
summary: My Two Cars follows a man forced to grapple with an absurdly epic daily dilemma: choosing between his two beloved vehicles.

name: Bass X Machina
summary: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.

name: A Feast of Fate
summary: In her past life, Su Miao was misled by slander and grew to hate Qin Yan. Only after death did she realize he had protected her with his own life. Reborn seven years back to the night she was framed and disgraced, she chooses to embrace the young man she once wronged. In this new life, she takes the initiative to stand by him and plot revenge together, swearing to take down the hypocritical Crown Prince and her vicious half-sister once and for all.

name: Muifei the Medium
summary: Returning to the atmosphere of Thailand thirty years previous, this story reflects the exploitation of the marganlised through a tribal woman whose life takes a dark turn, transforming her into a vengeful spirit.

name: Girl on the Run: The Hunt For America's Most Wanted Woman
summary: Branded the ‘Female Charles Manson,' Sarah Pender escapes prison sparking a nationwide manhunt.

name: L'Étrange Monsieur Duvallier
summary: This series recounts the travels of a modern-day adventurer, Raner, who hides behind the identity of Mr. Duvallier, a prominent figure. A former gangster presumed dead, Raner takes on the guise of an elderly, wealthy businessman to become a philanthropist and improve the human condition. Only his secretary, Laurence, knows his secret.

name: Bedtime Stories with Ryan
summary: Ryan Reynolds reads new and classic bedtime stories as the tales magically come to life around him – creating a warm, playful and imaginative wind-down experience for kids and parents to enjoy together.

name: DANG!
summary: DANG! follows a brother and sister duo whose fun, messy lives in New York City are interrupted when their worst nightmare comes true: their high-achieving older sister shows up and wants to hang out with them.

name: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese
summary: Three teenage girls share an unbreakable bond until terrible secrets threaten to emerge on social media. When one friend vanishes, the search for answers unearths a web of lies, betrayal, and murder - sending shockwaves through an unsuspecting community.

name: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars
summary: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars welcomes back queens with unfinished business to compete for the chance to be crowned "Canada's Ultimate All-Star," and win a cash prize of $100,000.

name: Mad Concrete Dreams
summary: In Korea, nothing defines success more than owning a building. Ki Su-jong, once an ordinary office worker, believes that going all in—risking everything and drowning in debt—to finally become a landlord will be his way out. But when global capital swoops in and threatens to push his building into foreclosure, Su-jong clings to a desperate plan with his best friend: a staged kidnapping in the building's basement that spirals into a real one. Trapped in a chain of crimes that could destroy his life or save it, Su-jong is forced to make impossible choices. How far will he go to keep his dream from collapsing?

name: Bake Your Dream
summary: The global pastry survival project, Bake Your Dream, brings together the world's finest masters. From Korea's top pastry chefs and world-renowned patissiers to hidden gems with extraordinary recipes, contestants armed with their own secret weapons and distinct philosophies take the stage to vie for the ultimate title. Amidst fierce missions, will the veterans shine with their flawless technique, or will bold, fresh ideas steal the spotlight? With their unique characters, philosophies, and skills at their fingertips, the battle begins the moment they step before the oven. Taste, aroma, devotion, and creativity collide in this arena as the world's most enchanting pastries are born.

name: Hundarna
summary: Some of the country's most driven defense attorneys work at the law firm Matsson & Moradi, and they risk ending up dangerously close to the limits of the law and morality. Cast: Arvin Kananian, Björn Bengtsson, Tiril Wishman, Kit Walker Johansson and others. Director: Lisa Linnertorp. Based on an original idea by Jens Lapidus.

name: Жди меня
summary: The "Zhdi Menya" program is a large—scale television project that uses unique artistic means to create a high sense of belonging among viewers to the destinies of other people and the history of the country. The true drama, subtle lyrics and artistic persuasiveness of the program determine its national recognition and enormous impact on the audience, confirmed by the multimillion response in Russia and abroad.

name: Solveig og Johns dolce villa
summary: Solveig and John is renovating a house in Italy

name: Quanqiu Gao Wu
summary: The 28-year-old Fang Ping was accidentally reborn in a parallel world in 2008, returning to his 18-year-old high school self. This is a world composed of a warrior system, where warriors have extremely high social status and rights. Due to the coincidence of fate with Emperor Zhan Tian in his previous life, a martial arts system was generated in Fang Ping's body after his rebirth. He can convert rare props of any value into martial arts value by touching them, and improve a series of abilities such as bones, tendons, flesh, blood, and mental strength at a speed beyond ordinary people. Through the system's golden finger and his own mind, Fang Ping successfully entered Modu Wuke University for further studies, and in the years to come, he continued to complete his self-growth. Faced with unknown difficulties, he gradually realized the responsibilities that warriors need to bear and the mission of protecting family, friendship, and love.

name: Rahma
summary: After years of suffering, Rahma ends up in a tyrannical marriage. Torn between seeking revenge and rewriting her destiny, Rahma gathers the strength to face her past and build herself a new life.

name: Sobrevivir al Paraíso: Más allá de los Testigos de Jehová
summary: Former members of the Jehovah's Witnesses share their stories of lesser-known aspects of the faith that have remained hidden for decades.

name: Morderca szyty na miarę
summary: This chilling docuseries chronicles one of Poland's most notorious cold cases -- the brutal 1999 murder of female student Katarzyna Zowada.

name: Hunting Outback Gold
summary:
Two life-long friends lead a daring expedition deep in the Australian Outback, to find a legendary, multi-billion-dollar fortune in gold and solve a 100 year old mystery. In 1897 gold prospector, Harrold Lasseter, staggered out of the desert claiming to have discovered a massive outcrop of gold.

Decades later, he set out to rediscover his lost fortune, alone he perished in the desert, taking the location of his gold to the grave.

Six outback missions and 40 years later, Jeff and Brendan are more determined than ever to find Lasseter's gold and prove that he was a telling the truth. Now with specialist help and cutting-edge technology, they plan to retrace Lasseter's fateful 1930 expedition, scouring the Outback for clues that Lasseter left behind that will lead them to his fortune. Their quest: survive the outback, discover the truth…and just maybe become billionaires in the process!

name: Reset
summary: Reset centres on Gidi Bar-Lavi, a 50-year-old man who is mistakenly diagnosed with a terminal illness. Believing he is about to die, Gidi embarks on a spectacular life implosion: quitting his job, destroying his marriage, torching relationships and embracing reckless freedom. When the diagnosis turns out to be wrong, Gidi is forced to confront the wreckage he's left behind — and the far harder task of facing life instead of death. But now, faced with the before and the aftermath, which life will he choose?

name: Concrete Market
summary: After the Great Earthquake, the world is razed to the ground. In the lone apartment complex left standing, survivors have established the Hwang Gung Market, where cash is dead and canned food is the new currency. Everything, from fuel to intelligence, is traded here. Park Sang-yong, the President of the Merchants, rules the market with an iron fist, forcing people to find their own ways to survive under his absolute order. But the status quo is shattered when a mysterious girl, He-ro, sneaks in to steal canned food. After discovering Sang-yong's fatal secret, she proposes a treacherous deal to his right-hand man, Tae-jin. As the Market's solid order begins to crack, alliance and betrayal become mere choices for survival. Who will endure to emerge as the master of the Market?

name: Famous Last Words
summary: Famous Last Words, a groundbreaking documentary series spotlighting renowned cultural icons secretly giving their final interviews - which will be announced and aired posthumously.

name: A World Worth Protecting
summary: In the fantastic future world with rich spiritual energy, the enthusiastic and cheerful little fatty Wang Baole saw through the illusion created by the teachers in the entrance examination of the famous "Mischievous Taoist Academy", who won high scores with his outstanding performance, and obtained the special quota of "Magic Soldier Department". Later, he overcome obstacles and opened up his own way of growing. In the process of cultivating immortals and fighting monsters, he made a large number of close friends, and thus started a series of hilarious adventure stories.

name: Busted! Darklord
summary: In an attempt for survival, Yu Renjie, the son of the demon lord, was ordered to enter Hero's Academy which only recruits distinguished and upright disciples. The goal is to obtain a Hero's Certificate which can bring legitimacy to the demon clan. This is extremely dangerous. Once the identity of a demon cultist is exposed, countless righteous knights will kill them on the spot. But on the first day of school, Yu Renjie was shocked to find out that his personal information had been leaked. In order to hide his identity, he had no choice but to put on women's clothing. His dangerous and hilarious campus life is about to unfold!

name: Tiger Coming In
summary: The fun and mysterious daily life of a young couple in a forest and strange children who come to them one day.

name: In the City
summary: In the city that never sleeps, a group of New Yorkers navigates the biggest transitions of their lives — marriage, parenthood, reinvention, and the reality of growing up without growing apart. Can they have it all, or will they need to choose between the lives they've built and the futures they never saw coming?

name: LA Firestorm: Inside the Inferno
summary: Combining personal stories and footage to take you inside the destructive firestorms that tore through Los Angeles in January 2025.

name: Contrast
summary: Kanata is a handsome young man who can't help but be the center of attention, even when his mind is miles away. Akira is the perfect student who barely talks to anyone. They don't know each other's classes or even their names, but they can't forget each other's faces. One day, these two happen to meet on a stairwell near the rooftop. From then on, that roof becomes their secret rendezvous spot. Slowly they discover that while they might be very different on the outside, they both have feelings for each other. Is this a case of opposites attract, or are the differences too great for them to ever truly connect?

name: Фермерство під час війни
summary:
The series tells the story of how Ukrainian farmers overcome the challenges of war and how Russian aggression exacerbates the world's food crisis.

The heroes of the film are employees of large-scale enterprises, owners of farms and local entrepreneurs. Some of them were forced to relocate their farms, others - to withstand the horrors of occupation, enemy shelling, mining of fields and other disasters caused by Russian troops.

name: Повернення додому
summary: We explore the stories of Ukrainians who could have lived and worked abroad, but returned during a difficult time for Ukraine to be useful and help locally: fighting, volunteering, starting businesses, etc.

previousepisode.name: Обрати військо замість Шрі-Ланки, Кіліманджаро і кар'єри в США

name: Revealed with Jules Asner
summary: Join host Jules Asner when she interviews some of the hottest stars of today. Including Alyssa Milano, Mike Myers, and Jennifer Love Hewitt. You will find out about the star's marriage life, childhood, claim to fame and more! So sit down and enjoy the Revealed life of a star.

name: Відновлення міст
summary: Rebuilding cities is not just about construction, but about restoring life, communities and meaning after the destruction caused by war. That is why, as part of the "Rebuilding Cities" project, we are telling the story of how Ukrainian towns and villages scarred by war are coming back to life.

previousepisode.name: Відновлення Києва: укриття, багатоповерхівка на Лобановського й урбанвізія

name: Glaze of Love
summary: Xu Xiao is a gifted yet arrogant restoration specialist with exceptional craftsmanship, while Zhao Xiaocen struggles with social anxiety. The two meet in a ceramics restoration class and become partners. With Xu Xiao's support, Zhao Xiaocen gradually opens up, while Xu Xiao, influenced by her, begins to reconcile his family conflicts. After enduring misunderstandings and setbacks in their relationship, they find their way back to each other. Together, they embark on a journey to preserve cultural heritage and face the challenges of the future.

name: De Drop: De Engste Roadtrip
summary: The guys from StukTV take six well-known friends on a terrifying road trip to England's four most notorious haunted locations. They are dropped off at night and confronted with inexplicable stories, bizarre sightings, and their own fears. Each location is more intense than the last. Every night becomes more exciting. Fate decides each night which daredevils must face their fears. Who is the least afraid and will survive... De Drop?

name: Deano
summary: Deano is a spirited cheeky charmer of a boy, whose tough exterior coats a real heart of gold. He is the most endearing feisty kid growing up in a ruthlessly tough neighbourhood in a house that should be condemned. He has no concept that the chips are stacked against him and embraces everyone equally, from the local teenage dropouts to the town police chief. At the heart of the series is Deano's friendship with Kit, his timid best mate from the wealthy side of town.

name: The Good Old Days
summary: Entertainment series which ran from 1953 to 1983 and recreated the atmosphere of the music hall with songs and sketches of the era performed by modern-day performers.

name: Standoff: The FBI, Power and Paranoia
summary:
CNN Original Series Standoff: The FBI, Power and Paranoia will examine the fragile, high-risk relationship between FBI Directors and then U.S. Presidents they serve, spotlighting the moments when that balance is pushed to the brink.

Each episode focuses on a defining confrontation that reverberated far beyond the Oval Office, starting with former FBI Director James Comey's own account of his infamous clash with President Donald Trump. Episodes also uncover the long-simmering fracture between J. Edgar Hoover and President Richard Nixon, the strained relationship between President Bill Clinton and FBI Director Louis Freeh, and the post-9/11 alliance between President George W. Bush and FBI Director Robert Mueller. Pulling back the curtain on pivotal clashes between FBI Directors and Presidents of the United States, the series traces how personal loyalties, political pressure, and questions of power have shaped the FBI's role in American democracy and national security through archival footage, expert analysis, and firsthand accounts.

name: Lobo, Morir Matando
summary: Tras un evento trágico, el exdetective Lobo Rosales debe proteger a Renata, la hija de la mujer que alguna vez amó. Juntos cruzan la frontera y forjan un vínculo frágil que pondrá a prueba los límites de la lealtad, el amor y la redención.

name: Henry David Thoreau
summary: HENRY DAVID THOREAU examines the life and work of the 19th-century writer in the context of antebellum New England and the larger United States, as well as through the universal themes he focused on in his writings: an individual's relationship to the state, how to live an authentic life, our connection to nature, and the impact of race on American life. Set against the political and social tensions of the mid-19th century, the film traces Thoreau's journey from his early days in Concord, Massachusetts to his deep engagement with the moral crises of his time, including industrialization, slavery, war, and environmental degradation. Through his essays, journals, and landmark works such as Walden and Civil Disobedience, he became an inspiration for generations of writers, thinkers, and activists.

name: Girls About Town
summary: Tired of slaving over the kitchen sink, Brenda Liversedge and Rosemary Pilgrim are keen to strike a blow for women's liberation. If this attracts the attention of their lesser halves, so much the better!

name: The Imperial Palace
summary: The Imperial Palace of Japan showcases peerless artworks, craftsmanship, and a tradition of thoughtful hospitality. Join us on a journey into a world of supreme aesthetic elegance.

name: Do You Know Your Place?
summary: Vernon Kay challenges celebs on the people and places they think they know best, while Traitors star Paul Gorton is the unreliable tour guide with the fun facts - and fibs.

name: Lost Women of Alaska
summary: As Native women vanish in Alaska, police must look to the past and a warning that went unheeded to discover the truth about a serial killer; as the net tightens, questions only grow about how many women this killer could have silenced.

name: BRABUS: One Second Wow
summary: At the center of the series is Constantin Buschmann, who, as a young CEO and owner, continues the life's work of his father, BRABUS founder Bodo Buschmann, and together with his team leads the family-owned company into its second generation and the future. The series follows Constantin and his partner Mili Umicevic as they navigate life as a power couple, mastering the challenge of balancing working together, brand culture and private life, while offering personal insights far beyond the BRABUS showroom. "BRABUS: One Second Wow" delivers a unique behind-the-scenes look at a global luxury brand and the people behind it – spanning hard work, intense pressure, jet-set lifestyles and international events from Beverly Hills to Milan. Featured throughout the series are select BRABUS celebrity clients and business partners from Europe and the United States.

name: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
summary: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies reveals real-life missions of elite intelligence officers, taking viewers deep into the world of espionage. From covert ops behind enemy lines to the hunt for bin Laden, uncover the untold, high-stakes stories that show what it truly takes to be a spy beyond the red line of danger.

name: Final Siren: Inside the AFL
summary: In one of the tightest seasons in AFL history, Final Siren follows seven of the game's biggest names - Marcus Bontempelli, Nat Fyfe, Max Gawn, Toby Greene, Touk Miller, Cam Rayner and Dayne Zorko - as public doubt, online abuse, injuries, ageing, suspensions, and fierce rivalries threaten to derail what could be their shot at Premiership glory.

name: AI Confidential with Hannah Fry
summary: Hannah Fry takes a deep dive into some of the most extraordinary human stories emerging from the world of AI, from falling in love with a chatbot to life and death decisions made by robots.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets∽
summary: 五等分の花嫁∽ is a short, self‑contained summer‑vacation story that takes place after the main series and focuses on quieter emotional moments rather than plot progression. Fuutarou and the quintuplets spend several days together away from school, and the episodes follow their interactions as each sister reflects on how her feelings toward him have changed. The atmosphere is relaxed and warm, with small character beats, private conversations, and gentle comedic moments that highlight the sisters' personalities. Nothing major is resolved, but the OVA fills in emotional space the TV seasons skipped, showing how their relationships soften and mature before the final stretch of the story.

name: Kol's World
summary: As huge fans of storytelling and animation Coy had an incredible opportunity to partner with KolTV and assist in producing 2 seasons of a ground-breaking animated children's series entitled Kol's World. The series was the first to feature a boy in a wheel chair as the main protagonist who went on daily adventures with his 2 best friends – Bella the songbird and Terri the Terrior pup, – meeting new animal friends along the way and learning valuable lessons.

name: Chasing A Killer: Gary Allen
summary: When Gary Allen is acquitted of murdering Samantha Class in 2000, detectives know it's only a matter of time before he strikes again. In 2019, the murder of another woman, Alena Grlakova, leads detectives once again to Gary Allen, unearthing chilling evidence which changes the course of the investigation and entwines Alena and Samantha's cases forever. Can he finally be brought to justice?
